description: This header file defines internal function prototypes for the Slap Object Broker component within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP). It includes function declarations for checking removability, setting path names, and managing object brokers, indicating it supports internal management of broker objects and their lifecycle.

methods.name: SlapOboIsRemoveable
methods.description: Checks if the object broker is removable.

methods.name: SlapOboSetPathName
methods.description: Sets the path name for the object broker.

methods.name: SlapOboGetObjBroker
methods.description: Retrieves an object broker by its path.

methods.name: SlapOboAddObjBroker
methods.description: Adds a new object broker at the specified path.

methods.name: SlapOboDelObjBroker
methods.description: Deletes the object broker at the specified path.
